issuing_body: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC) and Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
covered_actors: AI business actors involved in advanced AI systems
Public institutions (such as governments and municipalities) acting as AI business actors
prohibited_practices: Developing, providing, or using AI systems and services with the purpose of manipulating human decision-making, recognition, and emotion or on the premise of unconscious control
Using AI for profiling in fields where personal rights and benefits can be severely affected for inappropriate purposes
implementation_notes: Jointly issued by MIC and METI on April 19, 2024 (provisional English translation), integrating and revising three earlier Japanese guidelines (AI R&D Guidelines, AI Utilization Guidelines, and Governance Guidelines for Implementation of AI Principles ver. 1.1). Explicitly framed as non-binding soft law promoting voluntary, risk-based, and agile governance, maintained as a living document. Incorporates the G7 Hiroshima AI Process International Guiding Principles and Code of Conduct for advanced AI systems (including foundation models and generative AI). Explicitly excludes non-business users and data providers from its direct scope while advising compliance with existing applicable laws (e.g., Act on the Protection of Personal Information and intellectual property laws).
